name: Inkosi Mthiyane
role: Traditional council — holds the trust land
note: Has watched developers arrive and leave since 1998. Unhurried in a way that reads as obstruction only to people in a hurry. Knew Sakhile's grandfather, which opens the door and raises the standard.

name: Thandeka Nxumalo
role: Acting municipal manager — signs the permissions
note: Four years acting. Competent, overloaded, and the only reason anything is signed at all. Disappears entirely when the council is placed under administration.

name: Bra Sipho Zulu
note: Former shop steward, and it shows. Speaks for people who disagree with each other and will tell you so rather than pretend consensus. Went to school with Sakhile's older brother.

name: Renier van Zyl
note: Bakkie, golf shirt, genuinely good company. Will fund the forecourt tomorrow on terms that are excellent for the forecourt. The easiest money in the game, and the most expensive.

name: Dr Amara Okonkwo
note: The cheapest capital available and the slowest. Eighteen conditions precedent, a social and labour plan, and quarterly reporting until the loan is repaid. Takes Sakhile seriously earlier than the commercial banks do.
